title: Trump Sends Pope Leo Leo Wishes for Lung Cancer Recovery, Praises His Brother – Fox News
body:
President Donald Trump extended his well‑wishes to Pope Leo XIV on Wednesday after the pontiff’s doctors disclosed a diagnosis of lung cancer, while also revealing a personal connection to the Pope’s family that underscores the former president’s continued engagement with religious and political allies abroad. Trump, speaking at a rally in Ohio, said he hoped the “great leader of the Catholic Church” would make a “full and speedy recovery,” and added that he has known the Pope’s brother for years, describing him as a “friend and a proud MAGA supporter” whose home is “filled with memorabilia.”

The remarks came as the Vatican confirmed that Pope Leo XIV, who ascended to the papacy two years ago, is undergoing treatment for a malignant tumor in his left lung. Vatican officials declined to comment on the specifics of the therapy, noting only that the Pope is “receiving the best possible care” and that his condition is being closely monitored. The papacy, which has been navigating a series of diplomatic challenges—from the conflict in the Middle East to climate negotiations—has not yet indicated any changes to its public schedule, though the Pope’s health will inevitably shape future engagements.

Trump’s reference to the Pope’s brother, identified in Vatican circles as Cardinal Marco Romano, is notable for several reasons. Cardinal Romano, a longtime Vatican diplomat who served as apostolic nuncio to several European nations, has cultivated a reputation for being more outspoken on political matters than many of his peers. According to sources close to the cardinal, he has expressed admiration for Trump’s “America‑First” policies and has collected campaign buttons, hats and signed photographs from the 2016 and 2020 elections. The former president’s public acknowledgment of this relationship signals an effort to reinforce a narrative of personal ties with influential religious figures, a strategy he has employed since his 2016 campaign.

Analysts see the exchange as part of a broader pattern of Trump leveraging religious symbolism to sustain his political relevance. “Trump’s mention of the Pope’s brother serves a dual purpose,” said Dr. Elena Martínez, a professor of political communication at Georgetown University. “It humanizes the Pope’s family for his base, while also positioning Trump as a friend to the Catholic hierarchy, a demographic that remains pivotal in swing states.” The former president’s outreach aligns with his recent attempts to re‑enter the political arena, including hints at a 2028 presidential run and ongoing involvement in Republican fundraising.

The Vatican’s response has been measured. In a brief statement, the Holy See expressed gratitude for “the prayers and good wishes of all those around the world” and emphasized the Pope’s “steadfast dedication to his pastoral mission.” While Vatican officials have traditionally avoided direct political commentary, the acknowledgment of Trump’s message reflects a diplomatic courtesy rather than an endorsement. Observers note that the Holy See has historically maintained a delicate balance, fostering relationships with leaders across the ideological spectrum while safeguarding its spiritual authority.

The Pope’s health issue arrives at a time when the Catholic Church is grappling with internal reforms, including the handling of clerical abuse scandals and the push for greater lay participation. Should the Pope’s condition necessitate a reduced public presence, it could accelerate discussions about succession and the role of the College of Cardinals. Meanwhile, Trump’s public support may bolster his standing among evangelical and Catholic voters, a constituency he has courted since his first campaign.

Looking ahead, the intersection of health, politics and religion will likely remain in the spotlight. As Pope Leo XIV undergoes treatment, the world will watch not only his recovery but also how his illness influences the Vatican’s diplomatic posture. For Trump, the gesture of goodwill offers an opportunity to reaffirm his connections with faith‑based leaders and to keep his name in the international conversation, setting the stage for whatever political ambitions he may pursue in the coming years.
